_description: Compute bootstrap heldout ROC AUC confidence intervals for every saved model within one ancestry group.

_fields.precomputed_directory: Directory that already contains heldout_model_predictions_by_model/ or heldout_model_predictions.pkl.
_fields.target_ancestry_group: Requested ancestry label, matched case-insensitively after removing punctuation.
_fields.bootstrap_iterations: Optional. Number of bootstrap resamples. Defaults to 2000.
_fields.random_seed: Optional. Base seed used to derive deterministic per-model bootstrap seeds.
_fields.output_file_name: Optional. Output CSV file name written under precomputed_directory. A PNG plot with the same base name is written alongside it. Must be a file name only.
